routeHint: Needs an Identity row that is still pending, so the Validate button, the Reject reason select and the Change identity data button all render. Record 29454 belongs to member 312711 (Mia Ashford). The old target, 29447, was already rejected (only a red tag and a lone Reopen button) and its header name contradicted the extracted fields. Not 29472 either: templates-political-party/party-identity-review shoots that one.
alt: Identity validation review screen showing the uploaded document on the left and the extracted first name, last name, personal number, birth date, document serial and number, issue and expiry dates on the right, with Validate, Reject and Change identity data controls
notes: Every identity row in the obfuscated tenant had media_id NULL, so the left half of the frame rendered as empty white where the document belongs. media.content_url is varchar(255), which is too short for a raster data URI, but mediaSrc (client/src/utils/functions.js:152) returns contentUrl.replace('demo__','') for any value containing demo__, so a 248-character 'demo__data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg ...>' placeholder does fit and renders locally with no network call and no real document. Media 990002 (blue) is on 29454 and 990003 (green) on 29472 so the two identity screenshots do not share artwork. Separately, identity.first_name/last_name were seeded from an unrelated 'Bennett' pool; all 30 records on tenant 282 were resynced to their member's name, and 29454 was given a plausible personal number, serial, issue and expiry date, so the header and the extracted fields agree.
